text: In the war of Baldur's Gate 3 control
schemes, one tool alone gives PC players
the superior game feel, the mouse. This
little guy lets you equip items, target
enemies with ease, order pizza mid-game
session, and even kiss girls. So, what
if you ran it over with a car? Can you
beat Baldur's Gate 3 using only the
keyboard? Short answer, no. You can't
even make a character without a mouse.
Though, if you follow a speedrunner rule
set, the game actually begins after
character creation, and thus our hero
Zugzug is born. Here's how I'll attempt

only keyboard controls to play. I

brand new container into the game, it
seems to reset the potential loot for a
future unloaded game region. For
example, in the graveyard, if I dig up
any random grave, it spawns in a coffin
container. Then when I take the boat and
I check the items, they will change. If
I reload the game and dig the graves in
a different order, then take that boat
again, the items keep being
re-randomized. It's kind of weird and I
hope I explained that well enough here.
